🎯 The mission of National Assets

To provide land to those who need it. To do that, we need to know what places there are all along Chile!

How do you play?

  1. 💬
    Listen to your guideTells you what happened in each era
  2. 🃏
    Explore the cardsThe level question is about them!
  3. 🔓
    Play the mini-gameEach mistake: −½ ❤️ take it easy!
  4. ❤️
    Answer the questionRight: +1 ❤️ · Wrong: −½ ❤️
